report_summary_check.hierarchy: Mean two noises per parent, then eight equal parents

scope_caveats: One frozen model, eight selected DEV parents and two existing noises; not independent-seed replication and not a new-generalization estimate.
C x coordinates scaled about model origin by FP32 alpha; no recentering. Width manipulation can also move an off-origin C center.
HALF is a semantic-region subset, not 50% of whole-chair faces. SEAT_HALF K=1,1,4,13; BACK_HALF K=8. Very sparse C has ambiguous intended completion.
Only 4 SEAT_HALF, 2 SEAT_FULL, 1 BACK_HALF, 1 BACK_FULL parents. Between-type differences are not a paired HALF-versus-FULL treatment effect.
All source-ID C open boundary is audited; no required interface/exposure registered, so S and E correctly remain NA. Unique parent GT is not an open-generation target.

Nonbase conflict-area queries retain original locations under affine transform and use normalized per-face area importance weights; no new samples. This paired estimator differs from freshly resampled iid area queries.
Continuous RAW lacking exact indexed C/F shared edges is not evidence of no conditioning learned. POST still having no legal edge only bounds exact attachment under this retained output contract.
Finite boundary-to-F distances use existing unique C boundary vertices and all finite F edges/surfaces; descriptive proximity is not legal attachment, no C self-match.
D0+GEO_C+orientation is a bundled POST change, with free-face deletion. RAW-to-POST quality changes cannot be assigned to D0 alone.
Visual review is known-variant nonblind AI_PROXY, 32 pages/96 rows; UNCERTAIN retained and not scored as failure. Rendering metadata notes slight title overlap, geometry reviewed.
Transformed C-only cases do not re-evaluate source Y geometry or prove source-target reconstruction. Width findings do not certify height response.
Changing C moves the distance queries themselves. A shorter C-to-F distance under alpha change does not by itself show that F responded.
RAW exact-coordinate soup has no welded edges, so zero RAW nonmanifold edges must not be ranked as better topology than indexed POST.
The small audit retains selected paired findings; all 96 inherited and 4 descriptive per-output values remain in the frozen original tables, not omitted from measurement.
key_findings: All 96 inherited-plus-four-descriptive stage records have finite values; 768 AVMR/PMR setting rows have PASS. C coordinate and source-connectivity preservation pass on all 96 records.
All 96 records have zero legal C/F shared edges and zero oriented reachable free area. Strict vertex match gains after POST are isolated matches, not legal interface gains.

RAW to POST lowers FF by 68.955 to 71.651 percentage points, all 8 parents with both noises lower for every alpha. It also removes free faces: mean 148.75 RAW to 120.5625 / 117.5625 / 117.8125 POST for m095/base/p105.

RAW to POST makes mean C-boundary-to-F finite-surface distance larger for all alphas; parent distances grow on 7/8, 6/8, 6/8 parents. Mean C-boundary-to-F vertex distance grows on 6/8, 7/8, 7/8. Proximity and FF cleanup are distinct.

At POST, m095 versus base: FF -3.483 pp (7 lower, 0 tie, 1 higher), I +1.056 pp (1 lower, 1 tie, 6 higher), finite-surface mean distance -0.020486 model units (6 shorter, 0 tie, 2 longer). This is a tradeoff, not broad attachment improvement.

At POST, p105 versus base: CF -0.680 pp (4 lower, 1 tie, 3 higher), FF -2.622 pp (5 lower, 0 tie, 3 higher), I +2.081 pp (2 lower, 1 tie, 5 higher). Finite-surface mean distance +0.015985 model units (2 shorter, 0 tie, 6 longer).

The p105 POST I macro cost is tail-heavy: parent 5b1d0dad SEAT_FULL is +17.3828 pp against base with both noises positive; parent-level median is +0.109863 pp. For this alpha, POST versus RAW I has mean +0.2533 pp despite 6 improving parents, 1 tie, 1 worse; same FULL parent has +8.4473 pp.

The 4 SEAT_HALF parents do not share the FULL I tail: POST p105-base SEAT_HALF mean I -0.3540 pp (2 lower, 1 tie, 1 higher), whereas 2 SEAT_FULL parents mean +8.8501 pp (both higher). This is parent/condition heterogeneity, not evidence that HALF causes improvement or that FULL is generally harmful.

HALF conditions are very sparse semantic-region subsets: SEAT_HALF K=1,1,4,13; BACK_HALF K=8. The tiny panel cannot establish general recognition, height control, all-chair coverage, or a HALF-versus-FULL causal effect.
